        int cv = 0, ck = 0, cs = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) pos[i] = new ArrayList<>();

                ck++;

                cs++;
                pos[2].add(idx);

        for (int[][][] x : dp) for (int[][] y : x) for (int[] z : y) z[0] = -1;
        pw.println(dfs(0, 0, 0, 2, cv, ck, cs, freq, pos, dp));
        pw.close();

    static int dfs(int tv, int tk, int ts, int last, int cv, int ck, int cs, int[][] freq, ArrayList<Integer>[] pos, int[][][][] dp) {
        if (tv == cv && tk == ck && ts == cs) return 0;
        if (dp[tv][tk][ts][last] != -1) return dp[tv][tk][ts][last];
        int ret = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        if (tv < cv) {
            int p = pos[0].get(tv);
            int move = Math.max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = Math.min(ret, dfs(tv + 1, tk, ts, 0, cv, ck, cs, freq, pos, dp) + move);
        }
        if (tk < ck && last != 0) {
            int p = pos[1].get(tk);
            int move = Math.max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = Math.min(ret, dfs(tv, tk + 1, ts, 1, cv, ck, cs, freq, pos, dp) + move);
        }
        if (ts < cs) {
            int p = pos[2].get(ts);
            int move = Math.max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + Math.max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = Math.min(ret, dfs(tv, tk, ts + 1, 2, cv, ck, cs, freq, pos, dp) + move);

        return dp[tv][tk][ts][last] = ret;
